reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.text: Cute little shared cabin and dedicated host

reviews.author: Michael Und Christiane
reviews.text:
An old house with plenty of charm. 
We slept well and felt comfortable overall.
The kitchen was well equipped, and the shared bathrooms were sufficiently available.
Good location for glacier excursions.
A few minutes' drive to Höfn, which has good restaurants, but the fast route now costs 1500 ISK in tolls, one way. It takes about 12 minutes longer via Route 987.
reviews.original:
Altes Haus mit durchaus Charme. 
Wir haben gut geschlafen und uns insgesamt wohl gefühlt.
Küchenausstattung war gut und die Gemeinschaftsbäder waren ausreichend gut verfügbar.
Gute Lage um Gletscherausflüge zu machen.
Wenige Fahrminuten nach Höfn mit guten Restaurants, die schnelle Strecke kostet aber inzwischen 1500 ISK Maut, einfache Fahrt. Über die 987 dauert es ca. 12 Minuten länger.

reviews.author: Konrad
reviews.text: A great stay. Very friendly owners. A beautiful, cozy cottage in front of which a very nice kitten hangs around. The bathrooms were very clean, and the kitchen was well-equipped.
reviews.original: Świetny pobyt. Bardzo sympatyczni właściciele. Piękny klimatyczny domek przed którym zaczepia bardzo ładny kotek. Łazienki bardzo czyste a kuchnia dobrze wyposażona.

reviews.author: Klaus Jochen Friedrich
reviews.text: A very cozy room with a small kitchen for self-catering. Perfect as a starting point for glacier tours. And breakfast at Jon Riki is highly recommended.
reviews.original: Ein sehr gemütliches Zimmer mit kleiner Küche zum selbstversorgen. Als Ausgangspunkt für Gletschertouren perfekt. Und das Frühstück im Jon Riki ist sehr zu empfehlen.

reviews.author: Maci
reviews.text: Exactly as listed. Hostel style with private rooms and shared bathrooms. The experience felt rooted in Icelandic culture and the complimentary breakfast was a nice addition as you can’t beat free. If you are traveling Ring Road and need a one night stay near Hofn, this will do the trick.

reviews.author: Tony
reviews.text: Great views at a traditional farmhouse.

reviews.author: Emily
reviews.text: Host was very friendly and helpful. The breakfast in the morning with the Mountain View was epic .

reviews.author: Jenifer
reviews.text: Good breakfast which was included. Friends host

reviews.author: Jennifer
reviews.text: One of our favorite stays in our 10night ring road trip! Breakfast was great and totally made the stay better. The hosts are SO friendly and greeted us at breakfast since we got in late! The room was ADORABLE and bathroom was squeaky clean and the water was hot!

reviews.author: Vishal
reviews.text: Very comfortable place for 1-2 nights stay especially if you are driving around the ring road ! :)

reviews.author: 祉希
reviews.text: This is a quiet farmhouse at the foot of the glacier, with views of the glacier through the dining room window.The room is very cozy, the shared bathroom is fully equipped and clean, there is a separate small sink in the room, and it is very convenient to wash.The Host is very friendly, gave us a detailed explanation of the precautions of the house, and told us to pay attention to safety every day, really very warm.The breakfast is very generous, the restaurant is full of the owner's treasures, very personal!But unfortunately the winter bar is not open, if we come back to Iceland in summer we will definitely want to come back here for a drink ~
reviews.original: 这是一个位于冰川脚下的静谧农场民宿，透过餐厅的窗户可以望见冰川。房间很温馨，公共浴室用品齐全且干净整洁，房间里有单独的小水槽，洗漱很方便。房东很热情，有给我们详细讲解了房源的注意事项，每天都叮嘱我们注意安全游玩，真的很暖心。早餐很丰盛，餐厅里放满了房主的珍藏品，非常有个性!但是很遗憾冬季bar并不开启，如果夏季再来冰岛我们一定会想要回来这里喝一杯～

reviews.author: Stephane
reviews.text: Great hosting, very good breakfast, and beautiful views of the glaciers.
reviews.original: Super accueil, très bon petit déjeuner, et une belle vue sur les glaciers.

reviews.author: Sydney
reviews.text: The stay was outstanding! The room is located on a quaint farm and the complimentary breakfast made it a very valuable stay. The hosts are so friendly and have everything ready for your arrival. Perfect for an affordable stay in the countryside.

reviews.author: Mx
reviews.text: Lovely room and an amazing host. We enjoyed our stay immensely.

reviews.author: Amelia
reviews.text: The was a lovely farmstay surrounded by nature. It has a good view of the glaciers behind it, and the ducks, chickens, and cat are so adorable. It's well maintained, with quaint and homely touches. They have their own restaurant serving their home brewed beer and dinner (all you can eat 3 types of soup) if you don't feel up to cook in the shared kitchen. Beds were warm and the showers nice and hot.

reviews.author: Jeffrey
reviews.text: It is always a bonus when the host actually greets you and shows you around. They were very welcoming and the property was serene. The guesthouse was old but in good shape. Shared bathroom, but there are two of them plus there was a sink+mirror in our room. The included breakfast was perfect to get our day going.

reviews.author: Antonio
reviews.text:
Everything was perfect, it was like being at home!
Breakfast at Jon Riky (a very characteristic place) is abundant and varied. 
I'd be happy to go back!
reviews.original:
Tutto perfetto, è stato come essere a casa!
Colazione al jon riky (locale molto caratteristico) abbondante e variegata. 
Sarei felice di poterci tornare!

reviews.author: Clara
reviews.text: was very cozy & clean. thank you
reviews.original: war sehr gemütlich & sauber. danke

reviews.author: Carole
reviews.text:
The accommodation was as described and the bedroom with sink was a real plus. We were well hosted and were able to cook our meal in the small kitchen reserved for guests. The place is located in a very quiet area at the foot of the glaciers, it's beautiful. 
Breakfast was simply royal, a real plus for this place.
reviews.original:
Le logement était fidèle à la description et  la chambre avec lavabo était un vrai plus. Nous avons été bien accueillies et nous avons pu cuisiner notre repas dans la petite cuisine réservée aux hôtes. Le lieu est situé dans un endroit très calme au pied des glaciers, c'est magnifique. 
Le petit-déjeuner était tout simplement royal, un vrai plus pour cet endroit.

reviews.author: Lucia
reviews.text: Fantastic location, very friendly and helpful people. We found everything we needed, including a nice kitten, Laura. It is the perfect place for those looking for tranquility, at the foot of the glacier. The rooms are very nice, as are all the other rooms.
reviews.original: Posizione fantastica, persone molto cordiali e disponibili. Abbiamo trovato tutto quello si cui avevamo bisogno, tra cui anche una simpatica gattina, Laura. è il posto perfetto per chi cerca tranquillità, ai piedi del ghiacciaio. le stanze sono molto carine, così come tutti gli altri ambienti.

reviews.author: Alyssa
reviews.text: Lovely stay outside of Hofn. The room and shared bathrooms were very clean. Having the sink in our private room was a nice addition! Breakfast was lovely and the surroundings were beautiful!

reviews.author: Jane
reviews.text: Great location, and good breakfast. Loved our room, and the shared bathroom was not a problem.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.text: This place was fantastic for our one night stay. We enjoyed how kind the owners are and the free breakfast was delicious and a great way to start our morning. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Stefania
reviews.text: Really a nice place and Gudrun and his wife are very welcoming. The restaurant where you have breakfast is very special and their jams are delicious!
reviews.original: Veramente un posto carino e Gudrun e sua moglie molto accoglienti. Il ristorante in cui si fa colazione è molto particolare e le loro marmellate buonissime!

reviews.author: Célia
reviews.text:
Great place!
The room was perfect, as well as the shared spaces (kitchen and bathroom).
The hosts were amazing and everyone down there was nice, we were able to meet nice people:)
Breakfast is really a plus to be noted! Very nice and very good with everything for all tastes (coffee, tea, juice, milk, bread, cheese, vegetables, fruits, cakes, sausage...).
We loved it and would recommend it!
reviews.original:
Super logement !
La chambre était parfaite, ainsi que les espaces partagés (cuisine et salle de bain).
Les hôtes était incroyable et tous le monde la bas était gentils, nous avons pu faire de belle rencontres :)
Le petit déjeuner est vraiment un + à noté ! Très agréable et très bon avec de tout pour tout les goûts (café, the, jus, lait, pain, fromage, légumes, fruits, gâteaux, saucisse…).
Nous avons adorés et nous vous le recommandons !

reviews.author: Simone
reviews.text: Nice room and breakfast! Thank you 🤗

reviews.author: Pierpaolo
reviews.text: We loved our stay at Gunna and Maggi. Our room was inside the white house in front of the house where the owners live, where there are two common bathrooms and a kitchen. We fell in love with the place right away, reading the history of the owners and their family in a binder in the room, and as suggested we took a few steps inside the farm. Too bad we didn't see the reindeer, Magnus told us that they were only visible a few days before we arrived! Good breakfast with sweet and savory alternatives, and the jams of their production. Breakfast takes place inside their restaurant, where we could appreciate Magnus's collection of musical instruments with which we had a very pleasant chat. It was a beautiful stay that we will take to the heart and where we return to Iceland, we will definitely visit you again. Maybe next time with a double bass! Haha!
reviews.original: Abbiamo amato il nostro soggiorno da Gunna e Maggi. La nostra camera era all'interno della casetta bianca di fronte alla casa in cui abitano i proprietari, in cui ci sono due bagni comuni e una cucina. Ci siamo innamorati del posto subito, leggendo la storia dei proprietari e della loro famiglia all'interno di un raccoglitore presente in camera, e come suggerito abbiamo fatto due passi all'interno della fattoria. Peccato non aver visto le renne, Magnus ci ha detto che erano visibili solo qualche giorno prima del nostro arrivo! Buona la colazione con alternative dolci e salate, e le marmellate di loro produzione. La colazione si svolge all'interno del loro ristorante, in cui abbiamo potuto apprezzare la collezione di strumenti musicali di Magnus con cui abbiamo fatto una piacevolissima chiacchierata. È stato un soggiorno bellissimo che porteremo nel cuore e laddove dovessimo tornare in Islanda, sicuramente torneremo a trovarvi. Magari la prossima volta con un contrabbasso! Ahaha!

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.text: Welcoming couple and had a breakfast spread in the morning. Would visit again.

reviews.author: Rachael
reviews.text: Wow this place is beautiful.  We wish we had stayed more days than one!  We found it to be quiet and refreshing, and even saw the Northern Lights in our brief sojourn!  The farm location is pure magic, the historic buildings were unique and quaint, and the hosts were both friendly and helpful.  Breakfast was a great variety of fresh options, and such a lovely treat.  We enjoyed seeing all the musical instruments in the restaurant building.

reviews.author: Vlada
reviews.text: I loved our stay at the farm house! Very peaceful with a great breakfast. Loved the tomato jam. Thank you to our hosts, who were really helpful when I lost my camera in a nearby town and helped me get it back!

reviews.author: Leonardo
reviews.text: My stay at this property was excellent. The spaces are tidy, clean and cared for in detail, creating a welcoming and relaxing atmosphere. Breakfast is delicious, with a wide variety of quality products. The location is ideal: not only does it offer an amazing view, but it is also perfect for watching the sunrise, making the experience even more magical. The staff is friendly and always available. I highly recommend this property!
reviews.original: Il mio soggiorno presso questa struttura è stato eccellente. Gli spazi sono ordinati, puliti e curati nei dettagli, creando un’atmosfera accogliente e rilassante. La colazione è deliziosa, con un’ampia varietà di prodotti di qualità. La posizione è ideale: non solo offre una vista stupefacente, ma è anche perfetta per osservare l’aurora, rendendo l’esperienza ancora più magica. Il personale è cordiale e sempre disponibile. Consiglio vivamente questa struttura!

reviews.author: Lindsey
reviews.text: Our stay was great, we were able to catch a beautiful northern lights display. Also the big range of breakfast options is a great way to start the day

reviews.author: Ashwin
reviews.text: our stay was great... Thank you very much. The location was very good for the tour we had. the stay was very comfortable and warm, kitchen was well equipped and cozy. Gudrun was very helpful warm and lovely.

reviews.author: Naomi
reviews.text: Everything was very nice and the breakfast place had an amazing vibe.

reviews.author: Teva
reviews.text:
We had a lovely night in this lovely farmhouse.
Everything was clean and the host was very welcoming. When we arrived, he greeted us and showed the house.
We were also able to enjoy breakfast in the morning which was excellent and grandiose!
we recommend!
reviews.original:
Nous avons passés une agréable nuit dans ce joli corps de ferme.
Tout était bien propre et l'hôte était très accueillant. Des notre arrivée, il nous a accueilli et montrer la maison.
Nous avons également pu profiter du petit déjeuner le matin qui était excellent et grandiose!
nous recommandons!

reviews.author: Ram
reviews.text:
We had such a pleasant stay!
The room was cozy and comfortable, and the bathroom was very clean too. The breakfast spread was amazing—everything was fresh and delicious, with plenty of options.

reviews.author: Julie
reviews.text:
Very good stay and exceptionally nice host! 
It's just missing waffles or pancakes or breakfast to make everything great ….
reviews.original:
Très bon séjour et hôte exceptionnellement sympa ! 
Il manque juste des gaufres ou pancakes ou petit déjeuner pour que le tout soit excellent ….

reviews.author: Veronica
reviews.text:
The enclave is very nice and charming. They have sheep and visiting them is an experience. 
The couple who governs it is very friendly. 
The stay is simple, but you have what you need if you want to cook and the bed is comfortable. 
Breakfast is very delicious and you can see the glaciers. Fantastic place to see auroras if the sky is clear. 
Overall, great value
reviews.original:
El enclave es muy bonito y con encanto. Tienen ovejas y visitarlas es una experiencia. 
La pareja que lo regenta es muy amable. 
El hospedaje es sencillo, pero tienes lo que necesitas si quieres cocinar y la cama es cómoda. 
El desayuno es muy rico y se ven los glaciares. Lugar fantástico para ver auroras si el cielo está despejado. 
En general, excelente relación calidad-precio

reviews.author: Mayra
reviews.text: I loved this place, it was one of my favorites, hosts were kindly, always had been pending of what we needed and the breakfast was delicious

reviews.author: Yifan
reviews.text: The location is very close to Höfn and a glacier right behind the property. 20 minutes drive with 30 minutes hiking you can reach the glacier. Since it’s not touristic, the condition and overall surrounding is sensational. Breakfast is very good and many choices. The cat is very friendly and craving for attention. Overall I’m very happy with my staying and would definitely come back

reviews.author: Renae
reviews.text: A great stay! Thank you for your hospitality

reviews.author: Julianna
reviews.text: My friend and I so enjoyed staying here! It is beautiful and serene. The room was incredibly cozy and the provided breakfast was delicious! We would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text: Perfect for a one night stop on my ring road journey thanks for everything

reviews.author: Rich
reviews.text: Great stay!

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.text: Loved having breakfast included! The room was nice and private. Also great views!

reviews.author: Mathilde
reviews.text: We had a very good night at our hosts, the space is quiet, you will be welcomed, with a smile! The spaces are clean and pleasant, a nice discovery!
reviews.original: Nous avons passé une très bonne nuit chez nos hôtes, l’espace est calme, vous serez bien accueillis, avec le sourire ! Les espaces sont propres et agréables, une belle découverte !

reviews.author: Charlotte
reviews.text: Nice bedroom in a beautiful farm with a wonderfull view. Good breakfast with a tasty home made jam.

reviews.author: Joseph
reviews.text: This place was amazing. The stay still felt private in a guesthouse. The restaurant/check in area was decorated with instruments and was so beautiful. The hosts were so kind and even accommodating to help ship an item back to the US that we left behind. I would stay here again anytime

reviews.author: Francesco
reviews.text:
Very clean and nice staying, in a strategic position along the ring road in the South!
Hosts really kind

reviews.author: Pieter En Marijke
reviews.text:
Behind the house were glacier foothills. 
Very surprising.
The breakfast was excellent
reviews.original:
Achter het huis waren uitlopers van gletsjers. 
Heel verrassend.
Het ontbijt was uitstekend

reviews.author: Emilio
reviews.text: The accommodation is on a farm overlooking three glaciers, in a beautiful area in contact with animals and nature. The room was simple but comfortable, and the breakfast healthy and varied. It is also worth a taste of the restaurant soups, especially fish.
reviews.original: El alojamiento se encuentra en una granja con vistas a tres glaciares, en una zona preciosa en contacto con animales y naturaleza. La habitación era sencilla pero cómoda, y el desayuno saludable y variado. También merece la pena probar las sopas del restaurante, especialmente la de pescado.

reviews.author: Valerie
reviews.text:
Charming site with close proximity to glaciers and authentic.
Excellent breakfast at the restaurant in a country setting.
Cosy and bright bedroom.
reviews.original:
Site charmant avec la proximité des glaciers et authentique.
Excellent petit déjeuner au restaurant dans un cadre champêtre.
Chambre confortable et lumineuse.

reviews.author: Marzia
reviews.text:
very nice farm with beautiful view
we have been unlucky for the restaurant unfortunately closed, it seemed super and supplied with local and fresh food

reviews.author: Nicole
reviews.text: The stay was very pleasant and the place is easy to reach from the Ringstrasse.
reviews.original: Der Aufenthalt war sehr angenehm und die Unterkunft ist gut von der Ringstrasse her zu erreichen.

reviews.author: Roel
reviews.text: Very friendly hosts, clean room in amazing surroundings and good breakfast/dinner

reviews.author: Bastien
reviews.text: Pleasant stop on our journey in Iceland. We really enjoyed the savory sweet breakfast included.
reviews.original: Agréable étape dans notre périple en Islande. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié le petit-déjeuner sucré salé inclus.

reviews.author: Solveig
reviews.text: Guesthouse Hólmur is a lovely place overlooking Vatnajøkull, where you are greeted by cats, ducks, and free-range chickens. Both Magnús  and Gudrún were friendly and welcoming. The restaurant belonging to the place is cozy and original - and the food good! We can definitely recommend a stay at Hólmur.
reviews.original: Guesthouse Hólmur er et dejligt sted med udsigt til Vatnajøkull, hvor man bliver modtaget af katte, ænder og fritgående høns. Både Magnús  og Gudrún var venlige og imødekommende. Restauranten, der hører til stedet, er hyggelig og original - og maden god! Vi kan absolut anbefale et ophold på Hólmur.

reviews.author: Narayan
reviews.text: It was a great place to stay. 2 shared bathrooms, kitchen all very clean and maintained. The surroundings was beautiful. We had great time staying here.

reviews.author: Helen
reviews.text: We love this place! The room is beautiful. We were not lacking anything. We checked in late. The host came to meet us and gave us very detailed instructions. The host even provided nice breakfast the next morning. All in all, it is a nice place and we would recommend it to our friends.

reviews.author: Saman
reviews.text: We had an lovely stay and amazing view from the rooms and the restaurant! We loved the breakfast, there was plenty options for vega and vegan food. The family that host the bed and breakfast is very kind, friendly and helpful. We wished we stayed for more days!

reviews.author: Geoffrey
reviews.text: Very sweet, gracious family, with a touch of whimsy (Note the themes for each room). Though Jon Riki was closed for dinner, we did enjoy a delicious breakfast. And they offer some of their own homemade jam! Plenty to eat, lots of variety. If Jon Riki would have been open, we would have enjoyed dinner there too, and possibly some live music. The picture of the drum set and instruments is in Jon Riki. The host is part of several bands. Would definitely book here again.

reviews.author: Pommeline
reviews.text: Very friendly host, very nice cosy room and the breakfast was really good!!

reviews.author: Melanie
reviews.text: What a beautiful place! My  friend and I had a lot of fun staying at this haunted farmhouse by ourselves and walking around the grounds greeting the goats and old cats. Breakfast was great and in a really cool restaurant on the property. We were surrounded by glaciers all around. The owners told us ghost stories and played music during breakfast. Would definitely stay here again!

reviews.author: Maciej
reviews.text: homely atmosphere, friendly hosts, everything as described
reviews.original: swoiski klimat, sympatyczni gospodarze, wszystko zgodnie z opisem

reviews.author: Namho
reviews.text: It was an accommodation where I could feel the kindness and warmth of an elderly couple. ^ ^
reviews.original: 노부부의 친절함과 따뜻함이 느껴지는 숙소였어요^^

reviews.author: Christine
reviews.text: Excellent place! The location is beautiful, and the house is lovely. Very good breakfast with homemade jams, served in the family restaurant, with very nice decor. The hosts are very welcoming and warm.
reviews.original: Excellente adresse ! Le site est très beau, et la maison très agréable. Très bon petit déjeuner avec confitures maison, servi dans le restaurant familial, à la déco très sympa. Les hôtes sont très accueillants et chaleureux.

reviews.author: A.Erdi
reviews.text: Everything was nice. The restaurant ambiance was very good. I recommend it.
reviews.original: Hersey guzeldi. Restorantin ambiyansi cok iyiydi. Tavsiye ederim.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text: Nice quiet location outside of town. We stayed during our March trip on the Ring Road. Fantastic breakfast.

reviews.author: Francisco
reviews.text: Cozy and peaceful place! I recommend it!

reviews.author: Caroline
reviews.text: The host was very kind and fast! We were supposed to stay at camp, but changed minds on the road as we were very tired and the weather wasn't too good. We booked our stay in late evening and recieved our reply right away. We were nicely welcomed even though we booked just an hour before our arrival. The room was warm and nice, which is all you need for a fast sleepover. The breakfast was amazing! Big choice of food and what is really the best? The glacier View! The way it seems like it's flowing down to you. Really stunning. We loved the cat that welcomed us and the sheeps next to the house. Only thing we were sad about was that we didn't find any reindeers to adore.

reviews.author: Salomé
reviews.text: Great location, close to Höfn, and glaciers, very nice view from the farm, very comfortable bed!
reviews.original: Super emplacement, proche de Höfn, et des glaciers, très belle vue depuis la ferme, lit très confortable!

reviews.author: Merih
reviews.text:
We had a great time with Magnus and his wife who were super nice. The upstairs bedroom is superb, equipped and super pretty. The bathroom is warm, clean and equipped as well. We had breakfast in the restaurant and enjoyed ourselves:) 
Thanks again to our hosts who took great care of us and we hope to come back on our next trip to Iceland:)
reviews.original:
Nous avons passé un super séjour chez Magnus et sa femme qui étaient super gentil. La chambre à l’étage est superbe, équipée et super jolie. La salle de bain est chaleureuse, propre et équipée également. Nous avons pris un petit déjeuné dans le restaurant et nous nous sommes régalés :) 
Merci encore à nos hôtes qui ont été aux petits soins avec nous et on espère revenir lors de notre prochain voyage en Islande :)

reviews.author: Fabio
reviews.text: Nice place in a quiet location and nice bedrooms
reviews.original: Schöne Unterkunft in ruhiger Lage und schönen Schlafzimmern

reviews.author: Super-Mario
reviews.text: I had a great experience. Everybody in the house were welcoming and very friendly. The room was perfect for my stay, though it felt like I am at my aunts house. The bathroom, though shared, clean. It was nice to talk to the hosts at breakfast. It is a little working farm with sheep, chickens and ducks. Even saw a group of Reindeer passing through the field.

reviews.author: Nerijus
reviews.text: Nice place along the way. Rooms were clean and warm. Breakfast was pretty decent in a nice restaurant.

reviews.author: Julia
reviews.text: Guðrún’s and Magnús’ farm is a very lovely place! We’ve enjoyed our stay very much. It was very quite and we were surrounded by some sheep! We’ve also enjoyed the breakfast very much with homemade jam and a beautiful view over the Vatnajökull glacier. Guðrún also recommended some nice restaurants in Höfn which served some really good food. Thanks for having us, we would highly recommend staying at Hólmur for two to three nights!

reviews.author: Tom
reviews.text: This is a great place to stay if you are okay with a dorm-like atmosphere. You have to share the bathrooms, but we had no problems. Gudrun is a very good host who goes out of his way to help you get settled.

reviews.author: Maja
reviews.text: A very nice, lovingly furnished accommodation! The two hosts are super sweet and helpful - along with the rich breakfast for us the most beautiful place in Iceland so far! Clear recommendation :)
reviews.original: Eine sehr schöne, liebevoll eingerichtete Unterkunft! Die beiden Gastgeber sind super lieb und hilfsbereit - zusammen mit dem reichhaltigen Frühstück für uns die schönste Unterkunft auf Island bisher! Klare Empfehlung :)

reviews.author: Kevin
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time in Holmur and Gudrun & Magnus were amazing hosts!
Of course you can't expect completely new rooms and 100% silence at night, since you are sharing a historic house with several other people, but if you are prepared for that, the location is well worth it.
Our highlight was the dinner in the super cozy bar on the property with homebrewed beer.

reviews.author: Henrike
reviews.text:
The place surprised us with unusual furnishing details (glitter staircase, a huge faucet hanger on the door key, the Kuhthematik was continued in the room with more accessories, etc.) - very homey and refreshing!
Breakfast exceeded our expectations - the first morning there was even freshly baked bread! 
Thank you to Magnus and Gudrun for two unforgettable days!
reviews.original:
Die Unterkunft überraschte uns mit ungewöhnlichen Einrichtungsdetails (Glitzertreppe, ein riesiger Kuhanhänger am Türschlüssel, die Kuhthematik wurde im Zimmer durch weitere Accessoires weitergeführt, usw usw) - sehr heimelig und erfrischend!
Das Frühstück übertraf unsere Erwartungen - am ersten Morgen gab es sogar frisch gebackenes Brot! 
Vielen Dank an Magnus und Gudrun für zwei unvergessliche Tage!

reviews.author: Kendall
reviews.text: Lovely setting and lovely hosts. And breakfast was fantastic.

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.text: We had a lovely stay, it’s a beautiful place, well located and nice breakfast included :)

reviews.author: Mariana
reviews.text: Good place for our one night stop! The house was was super easy to find and drive to as it is just one turn away from the main road. We were welcomed by the hosts who showed us our room. They also allowed us to check-in later which was super nice. Everything was clean and the room was very spacious. Just be aware that noise travels a bit, I was woken up by other guests opening and closing doors early in the morning. Breakfast was ok. A bit pricey but overall a good stay!

reviews.author: Theresa
reviews.text:
The welcome was super nice. The family is very friendly. The soups in the restaurant right next door were really, really great. There were 3, one of which was also vegan. You can also enjoy home-brewed beer. 
The breakfast buffet was surprisingly extensive and varied. Perfect! 
The room was very cozy and the bed was comfortable. Everything seems very family-oriented, and we felt really comfortable. 
Everything is very lovingly planned, and you can feel the family's joy everywhere.
reviews.original:
Die Begrüßung war super nett. Die Familie ist sehr freundlich. Die Suppen im Resturant gleich daneben waren wirklich wirklich super gut. Es gab 3, eine davon auch vegan. Dazu kann man selbstgebrautes Bier genießen. 
Das Frühstücks-Buffet war überraschend ausgiebig und faccettenreich. Top! 
Das Zimmer war sehr wohlig und das Bett bequem. Es wirkt alles sehr familiär und wir haben uns wirklich wohlgefühlt. 
Es ist alles sehr liebevoll geplant und man merkt überall die Freude der Familie.

reviews.author: Martin
reviews.text: Very convenient location and easy check in/check out.

reviews.author: Stéphanie
reviews.text:
It's very pleasant to sleep here. The view is beautiful, and the "restaurant" in the farmhouse courtyard allowed us to have a good time.
The house beer is surprising and excellent. Very good place.
reviews.original:
C est très agréable de dormir ici. La vue est magnifique et le "restaurant" dans la cour de la ferme nous a permis de passer un bon moment.
La bière maison est surprenante et excellente. Très bonne adresse.

reviews.author: Cristina
reviews.text: This was a great place to stay while we visited Stokksnes and Hofn. The room is very spacious and the bed is comfortable. Angus has a lovely farm and we were able to walk around to see their baby chickens and sheep. The breakfast in the morning is very good and has many options (fruits, cold cuts,  jams, breads, etc). The curtains are not black out curtains and a lot of light comes through in summer time so I recommend you bring a mask.

reviews.author: Karin
reviews.text: You are accommodated together with other guests in the family's old farmhouse. The rooms are pleasantly large, and the two bathrooms are sufficient for the number of guests. The view of the two glaciers in the background is very nice. The breakfast in the restaurant is very good.
reviews.original: Im alten Bauernhaus der Familie ist man zusammen mit anderen Gästen untergebracht. Die Zimmer sind angenehm groß und die zwei Badezimmer ausreichend für die Anzahl Gäste. Die Aussicht auf die zwei Gletscher im Hintergrund ist sehr schön. Das Frühstück im Restaurant ist sehr gut.

reviews.author: Elinor
reviews.text: We had such a lovely stay. Beautiful surroundings. Had everything we needed and the breakfast was really tasty. Fabulous view of the glacier while eating. Thank you very much!

reviews.author: Una
reviews.text: Great location next to the glacier!

reviews.author: Maximilian
reviews.text:
Very pleasant place to stay. The rooms were adequate and had their own sink, which was very pleasant.
The hosts were very friendly.
The hosts run a restaurant nearby that is very tasty and cozy. The breakfast was excellent.
Highly recommend the whole thing.
reviews.original:
Sehr angenehme Unterkunft. Die Zimmer waren angemessen und hatten ein eigenes Waschbecken was sehr angenehm war.
Die Gastgeber waren sehr freundlich.
Anbei Betreiben die Gastgeber ein Restaurant welches sehr lecker und gemütlich ist. Das Frühstück war ausgezeichnet.
Sehr zu empfehlen das ganze.

reviews.author: Mirena
reviews.text: We had a great stay! Very friendly and responsive host, we had a trouble with our car and we had to check - in really late but that was not a problem, they organized it for us smoothly. We had a breakfast in the morning which is a big plus. Beautiful surroundings.

reviews.author: Kelley
reviews.text: Very cute little place with gorgeous views

reviews.author: Maggie
reviews.text: Clean, peaceful, good breakfast, clean bathrooms. Nice rooms.

reviews.author: Omar
reviews.text: We enjoyed the stay. Breakfast was great. The rooms were nicely decorated, and the hosts are helpful. The shared bathroom is clean!
reviews.original: Wir haben den Aufenthalt genossen. Das Frühstück war super. Die Zimmer waren süß eingerichtet, die Gastgeber sind bemüht. Gemeinschaftsbad sauber!

reviews.author: David
reviews.text:
The place was really authentic. Gudrun and Magnus were lovely. The breakfast was really nice and the restaurant was incredible with all the instruments. We got to play some piano and listen to Magnus playing it as well.
We’ll come back for sure!

reviews.author: Jenna
reviews.text: A lovely stay here! Beautiful farm, lovely hosts and a nice breakfast included too. Would highly recommend staying here!

reviews.author: Ruggero
reviews.text:
Perfect place to disconnect and enjoy the great view and surrounding. 
Peaceful farm with lots of animals around and an amazing breakfast in a cool spot full of instruments 🎸. 
We definitely recommend the staying here!

reviews.author: Rosie
reviews.text: Easy to find, beautiful location, peaceful and full of character

reviews.author: Anna Maria
reviews.text: Cute and scenic farm guesthouse, the breakfast was really good and we loved the cute and lovely bed decoration and key chains!

reviews.author: Andrea
reviews.text: Wonderful location for a one night stop while road tripping the southern coast. We especially enjoyed the breakfast and beautiful views. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Ophélie
reviews.text: A great stay at this farm! Everything was perfect. The included breakfast is a big plus because everything is delicious and some of the products are from the farm! I highly recommend it.
reviews.original: Un super séjour passé dans cette ferme ! Tout était parfait, le petit déjeuner inclus est un gros plus car tout est bon et certains produits sont de la ferme ! Je recommande vivement

reviews.author: Julie
reviews.text: Everything was perfect, thank you again 😃
reviews.original: Tout était parfait, merci encore 😃

reviews.author: Aurélie
reviews.text:
We felt right at home! Something more authentic than any other guesthouse we've stayed in so far. 
Great breakfast in a great place. 
Very remarkable glacier views, warm welcome and good homemade jams that you can buy!
We recommend
reviews.original:
Nous nous sommes sentis comme à la maison ! Quelque chose de plus authentique que toutes les autres guesthouses que nous ayons fait jusqu'à présent. 
Super petit déjeuner dans un super lieu. 
Vues sur le glacier tout à fait remarquable, accueil chaleureux et bonnes confitures maison que vous pouvez acheter !
Nous recommandons

reviews.author: Luuk
reviews.text: Great, friendly hosts who are always willing to help if you need any tips.  Glacier views, truly an amazing location.
reviews.original: Geweldig aardige hosts die je ook altijd willen helpen als je tips nodig hebt.  Uitzicht op gletsjers, echt een ongelofelijke locatie.

reviews.author: Delphine
reviews.text:
Excellent two-night stay, peaceful setting, and very friendly hosts! 
Please note: follow the directions in the description to find the hotel, not the GPS coordinates.
reviews.original:
Excellent séjour de deux nuits, environnement paisible et hôtes très sympathiques ! 
Attention, bien suivre les indications de la description pour trouver l'hôtel et non l'emplacement GPS

reviews.author: Brianna
reviews.text:
Our stay at this adorable place was wonderful! They were flexible with our arrival time for check-in and then showed us to our room. I was a little worried about finding it at first because I am not accustomed to the Icelandic addresses, but using the km from the Glacier Lagoon I was able to get a good idea of where it would be along the Highway and then saw the sign to turn in. 
We had a beautiful view of the northern lights and the stars from our room and were able to go outside and get some nice pictures. 
In the morning they had a delicious breakfast with a wide spread of bread, jams, meat, cheese, fruit, vegetables, juice and coffee in a building they have onsite that they must have turned into a brewery (named Jon Riki). The view from the building was beautiful and it looks like they have live music there sometimes.  
They also had ducks, sheep, and at least one cow. 
We wish we had more time to stay here and enjoy the beauty of this area in Iceland.

reviews.author: Delila
reviews.text: Very sweet couple. You can tell they have had a life time worth of memories with all the little trinkets they have stored here: full of musical instruments and self made jams/beer. Very cool place indeed.

reviews.author: Susan
reviews.text:
Gunna and Magnus were great! Very responsive, friendly, and flexible! We arrived later than scheduled, and Gunna stayed up to wait for us and gave us a tour upon arrival. The other houseguests were quiet, and even though the guesthouse was quite full, it was fairly easy to access the shared spaces- bath and kitchen. The only complaint (which has nothing to do with the hosts) was after arriving late in the evening, we went in to use the kitchen and found a sink full of dirty dishes, and pans that we had to clean in order to cook our dinner :(
Otherwise, the space was as described and pictured, served our needs for a one night stay, and the hosts were very friendly.

reviews.author: Gesit
reviews.text: Gudrun and Magnus are such a sweet couple. They are very friendly. It’s a great place to stay. Had a complete and clean amenities. Special thing is the free breakfast they have, delicious. Very recommended place.

reviews.author: Chloe
reviews.text: I loved my stay here! Gudrun and Magnus are so kind and welcoming. The beds are comfortable, rooms are homey, and the cat who wanders around is so friendly as well! I felt very safe as a solo traveler here and would recommend it to anyone.

reviews.author: Nicole
reviews.text: Very comfortable stay. Felt right at home. The host felt like my mom or grandma with how friendly she was and the place was extremely cute and authentic. She stayed up later for us because we were delayed by a snow storm and was very quick to respond to my messages. Great place for northern lights sighting. The breakfast was sufficient and the surroundings are very beautiful. 30 minutes from diamond beach.

reviews.author: 확실
reviews.text:
I made a mistake in the date and booked it, but you helped me to use it.
Thanks so much.
Breakfast is delicious and the hosts are the most friendly
reviews.original:
날짜를 실수해서 예약했는데 이용할수있게 도와주셨어요.
너무 감사합니다.
조식도 맛있고 호스분들은 최고로 친절합니다

reviews.author: Davy
reviews.text:
Wonderful time and wonderful people.  We thoroughly enjoyed visiting with them and felt we left with new friends!  Their property is beautiful with the farm being built between a sprawling glacier and the ocean. Breakfast is in a separate building which has a restaurant feel just personal enough. The host sells products from the farm, a great chance to get a little off the tourist beaten path and taste some down-home Icelandic food! Would love to see the restaurant when it is running in the summer. The rooms were quaint though close together so courtesy amongst guests is needed. The shared kitchen space was handy, we cooked a meal or two on the stove the few times we got in late. All of it a cozy and usable space.  I wouldn’t plan on cooking anything too complicated as it is a small, communal kitchen.  The bathroom/shower is also a shared space.
This was our favorite stop on our trip and we will visit again if we travel to Iceland in the future!

reviews.author: Maja
reviews.text: Really a nice place. Sweet and helpful hosts. Lovely breakfast.
reviews.original: Virkelig et dejligt sted. Søde og hjælpsomme værter. Dejlig morgenmad.

reviews.author: Ziyi
reviews.text: Very good place, the hosts are so helpful and nice. Liked the breakfast, the dining hall is so beautiful.

reviews.author: Jenni
reviews.text: We stayed one night here. We arrived late in the evening and checked in without any problems. The room was as described and we slept well. Breakfast is excellent and the owner is lovely. We highly recommend 😊

reviews.author: Amandine
reviews.text:
We spent a very very good moment in your farm house. Its very cosy, more confortable, clean. You are so kindness people. There is a good soul in your farm. Two good nights. So we hope to see you soon. Thank you very much! And your breakfeast are so delicious ! 
Amandine & Mathieu from France (La Seyne sur mer)

reviews.author: Anthony
reviews.text:
Perfect ! Nice room and nice breakfast.
The hosts are very kind and available to help you without any problem!

reviews.author: Alma
reviews.text: Great stay and super nice hosts. The view was amazing, right next to the glacier. And they even let you borrow their instruments if you are up for a jam session!

reviews.author: Florian
reviews.text: Nice, friendly and clean. Easy checkin. Animals next to the house. Breakfast included. Great host and location!

reviews.author: Joshua
reviews.text: Lovely room, amazing location, beautiful breakfast and such friendly and welcoming hosts!

reviews.author: Francesca
reviews.text:
Authentic Icelandic farm experience in a not touristy place near by the glaciers. You can see the Aurora from here!
Super friendly hosts and if you come in the summertime the restaurant just few steps away rocks!
Amazing breakfast with a massive view

reviews.author: Bekah
reviews.text: Really wonderful experience! We wanted to stay in real Icelandic homes and this felt just like that ☺️ wonderful breakfast too!

reviews.author: Elizabeth
reviews.text: We enjoyed our brief stay here. The check-in was smooth and the host was very friendly and accommodating.  I saw the best show of northern lights of my entire trip at this location thanks to the fact that there is no light pollution at this lovely little farm. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jay
reviews.text:
My partner and I loved our stay here!
It was a quiet spot tucked away on a beautiful farm. The couple that ran the farm were so warm and kind.
They made delicious lamb soup and homemade bread which was a godsend during a storm we endured during our stay there.

reviews.author: Kathryn
reviews.text: Great little farm with a good location from the glacier lagoon. You’re free to walk around the farm and see all the animals. There’s a very friendly little cat who is quite the talker! Felt like a classic Iceland countryside stay with a great breakfast spread in the morning!

reviews.author: James
reviews.text: Loved this farmhouse stay. Comfy bed, awesome breakfast.  Great sunset over the glacier.  Friendly hosts. Extra welcome from the kitty.

reviews.author: Reena
reviews.text: We only stayed for one night and Magnus greeted us when we arrived late with our cranky baby. But he showed us around and we had all the facilities needed to clean our baby bottles and get him fed and put down for bed. Breakfast the next morning was really nice! I’m so grateful they had gluten free options! Our baby loved looking at the chickens and the hatchery after breakfast. Thank you for a lovely (short) stay!

reviews.author: Allison
reviews.text: What an idyllic place to stay. Very clean and cozy, and in a beautiful setting. Guðrún and Magnús were lovely hosts, and the food and beer on offer were wholesome and delicious. Would definitely stop here again!

reviews.author: Valentin
reviews.text: The room was very cozy and very clean, thank you for this stay!
reviews.original: La chambre était très confortable et très propre, merci pour ce séjour !

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.text: This is a fantastic find near the glacier and lagoons!!!  Owners of the farm are very welcoming and they have a restaurant with home cooked food and home brewed beer.  There are chickens, ducks and sheep all around.  The view of 3 glaciers and surrounding countryside is surreal!!! Accommodations are great, too!!

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text: This was our favorite stay of our trip around the ring road! Gudrun and Magnus were wonderful hosts that made us feel very welcome. We really enjoyed eating in the restaurant, chatting with them, and exploring the farm. Dinner at the restaurant was delicious lamb soup, homemade bread, and great beer. We were happy we stayed for 2 nights — we did a long hike at Jokulsarlon (30 mins away) and had some time to relax on the farm with amazing views of glaciers. Room was spacious and clean, and having a sink was nice. Bathrooms shared but were tidy. Farm is just up the driveway from the ring road which was convenient but far enough away to still feel peaceful. We are very much hoping to come stay again!

reviews.author: Susanne
reviews.text:
Cute place. Matches the pictures and descriptions in the listing. I would definitely love to stay there again. There was a delicious lamb soup in the restaurant, and a very appealing buffet for breakfast. There was also homemade jam and beer.
In the background of the house is the glacier - in the evening we were lucky and could watch a very nice sunset...👍
reviews.original:
Süße Unterkunft. Entspricht den Bildern und Beschreibungen vom Inserat. Ich würde auf jeden Fall wieder sehr gerne dort übernachten. Im Restaurant gab es eine leckere Lammsuppe, zum Frühstück ein sehr ansprechendes Büffet. Außerdem gab es noch selbstgemachte Marmelade und Bier.
Im Hintergrund vom Haus ist der Gletscher - abends hatten wir Glück und konnten einen sehr schönen Sonnenuntergang beobachten …👍

reviews.author: Julie
reviews.text: Very nice setting in a beautifully renovated farmhouse. Very pleasant hosts.
reviews.original: Très beau cadre dans une ferme joliment rénovée. Hôtes très agréables.

reviews.author: Annsley
reviews.text: We loved our stay here! Absolutely stunning location! We drove up at night when it was raining and didn’t realize the incredible view until the morning!

reviews.author: Chelsia
reviews.text: Hosts are friendly and welcoming! The guesthouse consists of 6 rooms (4 upstairs and 2 downstairs) with 2 shared bathrooms! Room 4 and Breakfast at the brewery restaurant offers an amazing view of the surrounding glacier mountains!

reviews.author: Daniela
reviews.text: Really nice place to stay in the region with sheep around you and comfortable rooms. Gudrun was very welcoming and the offered breakfast was delicious. The separate house in which rooms, bathrooms and kitchen are located was clean and spacious. (:

reviews.author: Geert
reviews.text: Wonderful hosts to an amazing guesthouse in the middle of Icelandic tranquillity. Even out-of-season, we could feel this place breaths genuine hospitality and guests are warmly taken care of. We wish we could have stayed longer.

reviews.author: Varsha
reviews.text: The most beautiful bnb with breathtaking views. The hosts are wonderful and serve very tasty jams that are made on their farm. A must stay that is perfectly located from Jokulsarlon and other sights.

reviews.author: Devin
reviews.text: If you want an authentic experience of Iceland I recommend giving this place a try. The scenery is postcard worthy and the guest area is beautifully kept. All in all it was a wonderful experience and I highly suggest staying here! There is also a free breakfast that is included with the room which is an awesome treat! Magnús and his wife were absolutely charming and encouraged us to explore the farm and to freely walk the grounds. If we could have stayed longer- WE WOULD HAVE!

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.text: Very friendly host family, beautiful views and so fun to see all the animals! The room itself was spacious and perfect for our needs.

reviews.author: Allison
reviews.text: Cute farm house with great accommodations, including a great breakfast, for a stopover across Iceland. Two bathrooms and a large fully equipped kitchen in the house makes for an easy stay in a shared house. Love the little lambs and all the farm animals!

reviews.author: Darko
reviews.text: Great host. Great breakfast. Really nice barn.

reviews.author: Mere
reviews.text: Our most warmly and generously hosted stay in Iceland - Gunna was amazing. Our room was cozy, breakfast was delicious, and Laura - one of the three farm cats - was the sweetest, strangest, fluffiest little love gremlin I've ever had the pleasure of petting.

reviews.author: Nivedita
reviews.text: Lovely guesthouse tucked with stunning views of the surrounding glacier and mountains with many charming and cute touches. Breakfast was absolutely delicious!

reviews.author: Jascha
reviews.text:
A very cute room in a nice old farm house with a nice view of the surrounding glaciers (and the farm). Communication was great and we enjoyed our time here. 
If you have dietary restrictions regarding the breakfast, I think the hosts would gladly have options for you.

reviews.author: Ricarda
reviews.text: Everything was wonderful

reviews.author: Antonio
reviews.text: Wonderful!

reviews.author: Sebastian
reviews.text: Well worth it. Very nice people and the breakfast is a great bonus. Would stay there again.

reviews.author: Eloise
reviews.text: Thanks for your hospitality! The house was perfect, and the breakfast was very good :)
reviews.original: Merci pour votre accueil ! La maison étais parfaite et le petit déjeuner très bon :)

reviews.author: Carter
reviews.text: It was a cozy and lovely stay. The outdoor cat was super cute, and the incredible amount of musical instruments at the cafe area was so cool to see.

reviews.author: Justin
reviews.text: Great stay, with a beautiful view of the mountains and glaciers and welcoming hosts. You cannot ask for a better scenic/serene view. If I ever return to Iceland, I’ll definitely return to this quaint farm.

reviews.author: René
reviews.text:
Nice and cozy room / house in traditional style. Breakfast was great as well. Easy and nice conversation with host by app as well as in person.
Thank you Gudrún and Magnús!

reviews.author: Lucie
reviews.text: Gudrùn Og Magnús are very nice !Magnus has a great collection of music instruments, the restaurant room is amazing and the house is cosy ! We had a wonderful time there !

reviews.author: Franziska
reviews.text: It was a great two day stay with Gudrun and Magnus! They were always available if something was needed and provides a nice breakfast and further advice every morning. The guesthouse has amazing views towarda the mountains and is situated very nicely to either drive to Jökullsarlon or Höfn in 30 minutes. The rooms were very clean and cosy. Thank you again for having us!

reviews.author: Jessica
reviews.text: This was one of our favourite stays on our Iceland Roundtrip! The hosts were so kind, their Guesthouse is absolutely lovely and we got a great breakfast. The location is great for exploring. We had a wonderful time at Guðrún and Magnús place and will definitely come there again in the future.

reviews.author: Gene
reviews.text: You will have a good stay here, the beds were comfortable, everything was very clean and the hosts were welcoming. You can take the road back to the glacier even w a small 2 wheel drive..great to get up pretty close. Lots of good selections at breakfast also. The hosts have a done a very good job of repurposing the farm.

reviews.author: Henry
reviews.text: Great place to stay with shared kitchen and comfortable rooms, but was unfortunate the restaurant is only open during the peak summer season which we weren’t aware of.

reviews.author: Joe
reviews.text: Holmur Guesthouse is a treat. The guesthouse, originally built in the mid twentieth century, was repurposed in 2005 as a B&B. It is charming and quaint, but the personal touches by Maggi and Gunna are what make the stay special. The breakfast buffet provided each morning made for a perfect start to our days. Our only regret is missing out on the family-run restaurant (with beer brewed on site), as it was temporarily closed for dinners during the off-season.

reviews.author: Nicole
reviews.text: Spacious and cozy room in an old, rebuild farmhouse. There is a small kitchen with acquipment and fridge that you could use, but there is also a restaurant nextdoors. In the morning, a lovely and extensive breakfast was served in the restaurant :)

reviews.author: Joey
reviews.text: This is a lovely house - all other guests were pleasant and respectful and we enjoyed our stay!

reviews.author: Andres
reviews.text: Our stay at holmur farm was absolutely amazing. The farm was located on a beautiful plot of land surrounding by scenic views and the gorgeous Icelandic nature. We were able to see the northern lights right in front of our room one night and look into a sky full of stars like we had never seen before. The room was comfortable, and just the right size. The accommodation also had a kitchen for cooking if you wanted to. Breakfast was included in the cute restaurant within the farm. Guðrún was a lovely host. Very kind and accommodating to our arrival time and even offered great recommendations for placed to eat in the nearest village. We loved our stay here. Very quiet and peaceful.

reviews.author: Alessia
reviews.text:
The farm is a 30-minute drive from Hofn, and 20 minutes from the ice lagoon, great location. The bathroom and kitchen are shared, but breakfast is included and there is a restaurant within walking distance that they say is excellent but unfortunately when we were there it was closed.
Check-in starts at 5:00 p.m., we didn't find anyone before. 
Silence assured and very kind hosts.
Nice place
reviews.original:
La fattoria è a 30 minuti in auto da Hofn, e 20 minuti dalla laguna di ghiaccio, ottima posizione. Il bagno e la cucina sono condivisi, ma la colazione è inclusa e a due passi c'è un ristorante che dicono ottimo ma purtroppo quando siamo stati noi era chiuso.
Il check in inizia dalle h. 17, prima non abbiamo trovato nessuno. 
Silenzio assicurato e host molto gentili.
Bel posto

reviews.author: Antonia
reviews.text:
We had a great night at Gudruns and Magnus farm. They are lovely hosts! Our room was clean and cozy.
We had a perfect airbnb-stay also because of the included breakfast.

reviews.author: Ray
reviews.text: This place was one of the highlights of my trip.

reviews.author: Cara
reviews.text: The farmhouse was a great experience. We were a little late for check in but we’re able to make it in time for dinner which was delicious! They room has a lock and our building had a bathroom outside our room for the four rooms. It was a great stay for our trip around the ring road. Really close to the glacier lagoons. Would stay again!

reviews.author: Courtney
reviews.text: We loved this cozy farm experience. Our room was great with a lovely view of the property. We did get a little confused finding the Check-In area, but it is located inside of where the restaurant and brewery is. We would highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.text: Great accomodation.

reviews.author: Madison
reviews.text: Truly a lovely stay! The guest house is well kept, neat, and has all of the amenities needed for a comfortable stay, and the scenery can’t be beat. This guest house is completely family run and we loved getting to know them, and the meals served at their restaurant are incredible. Don’t skip the breakfast! Their jams and pickled vegetables are delicious.

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.text: There are 2 rooms downstairs, and 4 rooms upstairs, with each floor having a full bath to share.  There is a communal kitchen that is very well stocked, and the instant coffee machine in the front hall makes excellent coffee!  Breakfast is in the nearby restaurant, and it is a VERY full spread!  This is included in the room rate.  Everything was super clean, and the hosts are very friendly and accommodating, as well as quite rapid with response time.  Excellent stay!

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.text: Cute place with good restaurant

reviews.author: John
reviews.text: If you are looking for the authentic farm house experience in Iceland this is it! Very charming property with a restaurant on site! The hosts were so welcoming and really made us feel at home. Great location as it’s just 20 minutes outside of Hofn. The property is surrounded by glaciers and dramatic mountains with beauty that cannot be matched. I highly recommend this place if you are exploring the southern coast of Iceland!

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.text: We had a great stay at the guest house. The hosts are incredibly nice and give good recommendations. And the breakfast was very yummy. Can definitely recommend the place!

reviews.author: Carlos Mauricio
reviews.text: Was a amazing experience, the house and all styles inside. The breakfast very good and views of glacier awesome. We will comeback for sure.

reviews.author: Emil
reviews.text: Nice and cozy place, we had a wonderfull stay there.

reviews.author: Mel
reviews.text: Unique and great stop on the Ring Road. For beer lovers its a must. The food was great!

reviews.author: Alexandre
reviews.text:
A favorite place to stay! Warm welcome, it feels like home.
Our hosts are jacks-of-all-trades: farm, inn, and restaurant, where they brew their own beers. We are also lucky enough to be able to see two tongues of the glacier from the property, and there is a great spot for viewing the Northern Lights right behind the house.
We highly recommend this guesthouse!
reviews.original:
Établissement coup de coeur! Accueil chaleureux, on se sent comme à la maison.
Nos hôtes sont des touches à tout : ferme, auberge et restaurant ou ils brassent eux-mêmes leurs bières. Nous avons également la chance de voir deux langues du glacier depuis le domaine et un superbe sport pour les aurores boréales juste derrière la maison.
Nous recommandons vivement cette Guesthouse

reviews.author: Alexia
reviews.text: This was a lovely place to stay and couldn’t be in a better location. The view of the glacier from the breakfast room makes it PERFECT!

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.text: I only stayed 1 night to get some sleep but the endearing environment made me wish I could have stayed longer.

reviews.author: Wendy
reviews.text: The farm is very beautiful, I like it very much, the landlord is very warm, the room is warm and clean, there is a feeling of home, and the breakfast is also very rich. A great experience

reviews.author: 有限状态机
reviews.text: The decor is unexpectedly exquisite, there is a shared kitchen, the breakfast is also very good, and the cat is also very cute.But I didn't see the sheep mentioned in the other reviews, maybe it was too cold to come out.
reviews.original: 布置出乎意料地精致，有公用厨房，早餐也很好，猫也很可爱。不过并没有看见其他评论提到的羊，可能太冷就没出来吧。

reviews.author: Janice
reviews.text: Very cozy stay
reviews.original: Sehr gemütlicher Aufenthalt

reviews.author: Jonathan
reviews.text: Wonderful setting, very charming accomodation and beautiful restaurant on site. We were here for 2 days after getting stuck with the large storm that hit Iceland last week and were very well looked after during our stay. I would definitely visit again and would recommend this place to friends and family.

reviews.author: Nathaly
reviews.text: Comfy and clean room! It was warm and the bed was very comfortable. Breakfast was fine, plenty of choice

reviews.author: Pamela
reviews.text: The room was clean, nicely decorated and warm.  The host showed us where the caribou were grazing and they had the best breakfast ever!

reviews.author: Natalie
reviews.text:
We spent one night here.  Loved it.  Country charm.  We were in one of 3 or four rooms.  Shared a bathroom with shower and a halfbath ( no shower) with the other guests.  No problem.  These guestrooms and bathrooms are in one building on the property.  All one floor/ first floor.  Outside door locked.  Our room door locked.  We had a small sink in the room.  And an extra bed we used to put all our things on. No closet or dresser but we were there for one night.  
There are chickens and ducks right outside.  Sweet.  Views of three glaciers.  As good as many of the main tourist attractions.  We saw northern lights right from the property.   Sadly the restaurant wasclosed but Gudrin recommended nearby Foss Hotel Restaurant which was very nice, very good.  Breakfast in another building was delightful.  Saw reindeer through their telescope. Gazed dreamily at the glaciers.   Dont expect anything glamorous .   But comfortable, gracious, authentic.   Convenient.  Was highly recomm nded to us by friends who stayed here.   We’d love to go back.

reviews.author: Nishida
reviews.text: I enjoyed dinner at their restaurant and its atmosphere was excellent:)

reviews.author: Elise
reviews.text: Very nice hosts! This is our favorite guesthouse from our whole trip around Iceland. The surroundings are beautiful, the view of the 3 glaciers from the restaurant is breathtaking. It is very peaceful, the food and the beer are delicious. The rooms are comfortable and tastefully decorated. It was our second time there, and we will come back on our next trip to Iceland !

reviews.author: Rishabh
reviews.text: Perfect location if you're looking for a place to crash near Hofn. The washroom and kitchen were shared. We wished if the kitchen and our room was in the same building. But we loved the breakfast provided by the owners. They have a cute restaurant where there's a nice buffet (has vegetarian food too). Would recommend this place if sharing the kitchen and bathroom is not a problem

reviews.author: Fenil
reviews.text: Beautiful and best location. Great breakfast as well.

reviews.author: Katrin
reviews.text:
We had an amazing stay at the place of Gudrun and Magnus. The room was clean and cozy, the bathroom is shared but was clean as well. The view is astonishing. Nature, glaciers and several animals :)
The breakfast was good and we would also recommend the restaurant for dinner in the evenings. The food was delicious. Would always come back!

reviews.author: Duncan
reviews.text: This is a very nice place to stay in the country side. The farm is pleasant with ducks and chickens wandering around. If it's bad weather you can hide in your comfortable room. The WiFi was good. The nearby restaurant and microbrewery also operated by the hosts does good food and great beer.

reviews.author: Abby
reviews.text: This place was awesome! The hosts are both so kind and friendly. They are quick to have a good conversation and share some funny stories. They have renovated the guest house beautifully. It was so nice to wake up and have the farm animals right outside as well as the most beautiful cat, Lorna. The included breakfast in the morning was also delicious! We were too late to try dinner at the restaurant, Jon Riki but it smelled amazing.

reviews.author: Luke
reviews.text: Tucked away just between some glacier outcrops and the sea. A micro brewery and restaurant right next door. Perfect stop when traveling around Iceland.

reviews.author: Ellen
reviews.text: The location and restaurant are both amazing! Such a fun place to stay

reviews.author: Francoise
reviews.text: Very good location, it's very cute, the hosts are nice and the breakfast is very good.
reviews.original: Très bonne adresse , c’est très mignon, les hôtes sont sympa et le petit déjeuner très bon

reviews.author: Joanna
reviews.text: Guðrún and Magnús’s place is a true hidden gem! The farm is lovely to explore, the rooms are cozy and the views are breathtaking (so many glaciers!). The included breakfast is delicious (you can also get dinner at the restaurant, which I 100% recommend.) You can really tell how much care and thought has gone into this place.  Wish I could have stayed longer!

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.text: Don't hesitate, family place, you feel like family
reviews.original: N’hésitez pas, endroit familial, on se sent en famille

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.text: I would recommend that you stay here.  It is very calm there and the beds are comfortable. There is a good amount of cooking facilities and it has an authentic feel.

reviews.author: Inês
reviews.text: We were extremely well received by Arndís, and had a very nice talk with her and also with the owners. What a lovely family! Such a beautiful place with a very nice view to the glacier. We had dinner at the restaurant with very good food. The breakfast is well served with delicious homemade pancakes. We enjoy it a lot!

reviews.author: Pilaiya
reviews.text: Lovely farm house with great view! Place was clean and got everything you need. Host was very nice and easy to reach. I enjoyed staying here and hopefully will be back again!

reviews.author: Russell
reviews.text: Authentic Iceland farm at the foot of the glacier with many cute goats and other friendly animals. Delicious breakfast buffet.  Excellent hosts. Saw some reindeer passing through. Accommodations had all that we needed. Use of communal kitchen is an additional benefit. Amazing views in all directions.

reviews.author: Taylor
reviews.text: Beautiful location and very cozy. Great food and lovely hosts. Wonderful atmosphere overall.

reviews.author: Helene
reviews.text:
Great time at Holmur! The house is cosy and the owners always there if you need something. 
Do not hesitate to order dinner (not included in the price) it was delicious!

reviews.author: Isabelle
reviews.text: Nice place to stay. Very good breakfast. Thank you.

reviews.author: Michael
reviews.text: The interior of the buildings are so nice and comfortable. The room was cozy and one of the two restrooms were always available. The views from the farm are spectacular. I really like the cute ducks, cats, dogs wondering around outside. The included breakfast in the restaurant was very tasty and lots of variety in the options. The family were very welcoming and down to earth. I would definitely stay again when back in Iceland.

reviews.author: Molly
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for two nights on our honeymoon. It was a lovely house in a great location, and the hosts were very cheerful and kind. We loved meeting other guests in the house. The breakfast was wonderful! Huge bonus: we got to see the northern lights.

reviews.author: Ted
reviews.text: We had a great stay in this beautiful location and would definitely return. Thank you!

reviews.author: Glenn
reviews.text: great stay. wifi is a bit low upstairs but the rest is great and as described

reviews.author: Beth
reviews.text: Awesome hidden treasure!

reviews.author: Gina
reviews.text: Lovely place, beautiful view and good food.

reviews.author: Jenna
reviews.text: This place is such a hidden gem! It is an adorable little farm house where you get an animal themed room. There is a common bathroom and a little kitchen area as well if you want to prepare meals. There is also the main restaurant on the property where breakfast is served each day and dinner which was delicious. Staying here was one of the highlights of our trip and would highly recommend! Thank you for the hospitality Guðrún Og Magnús’s!

reviews.author: Rebecca
reviews.text: This beautiful guesthouse exceeded all of our expectations! It was charming at cosy with lovely little touches (loved the homemade treats on the table!). Excellent bathroom/showers. Located right between Höfn and the lagoon, it felt serene especially in winter. The breakfast was phenomenal and Gudrún and Magnús were warm and friendly. Can't wait to come back here next time I'm in Iceland - hopefully next time in summer! :)

reviews.author: Ruoting
reviews.text: Breakfast included, great price, the boss and lady boss are very welcoming
reviews.original: 包含早餐，价格优惠，老板娘和老板很热情

reviews.author: Stephanie
reviews.text: We really enjoyed the stay at the farm house. The breakfast was also a huge plus-a good mix of local and traditional (for US) breakfast foods and very nice, hospitable hosts. Rooms were clean and it was easy enough to get to, even in the dark (when we had to arrive our first night). We enjoyed the restaurant for the night we ate there-great food and a nice intimate atmosphere. Great stay, would recommend.

reviews.author: Jeff
reviews.text: Wonderful little place, clean and small homie touches. Perfect if you’re like me usually traveling alone or with a single partner. It was close enough to the blue ice cave meeting spot that after our tour we only had a short drive back to sleep.

reviews.author: Mackenzie
reviews.text: Beautiful spot

reviews.author: Eline
reviews.text: We loved this guesthouse and the wonderful home cooked meal. Beautiful restaurant where they brew their own beer and very cozy rooms. Perfect location. We would go back any time!

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.text: Very clean place. The dinner was excellent and it was nice to sit down to a nice meal and not have to drive somewhere far. Would highly recommend this place!

reviews.author: Ioannis
reviews.text: Breakfast has been an unforgettable experience!

reviews.author: Magdalena
reviews.text: The family is very nice and friendly and we felt like home. The breakfast was delicious and prepared with lots of love.

reviews.author: Veronica
reviews.text: We arrived later than expected but were able to communicate this easily with our host and they accommodated us and were able to give us our keys a bit later. The room was nice and had everything you could need. The bathrooms were clean and well-stocked with towels. They have a kitchen in the guesthouse so that you can cook if you wish. They provided a very nice breakfast with many options - breads, treats, fruits and vegetables, meats, coffee, tea,  etc. Our stay was perfect and we would highly recommend it to others!

reviews.author: Charles
reviews.text: During our stay, we had the entire place so it was very quiet. The continental breakfast was amazing. Location is somewhat remote so make sure you message the host prior so you can't get lost. A very delicate and stylish place with a big room and your own sink. Definitely a good place to stay!

reviews.author: Philip
reviews.text: This place was just amazing! The guesthouse is an old house (very nicely kept) in a farm! The hosts are very kind and helpful and they welcomed us and showed us the place! We also asked to see the farm and the animals and very kindly they showed us everything.. very nice experience! The house was very clean, with food and with everything we could need! We also had a great breakfast! Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.text: Gudrun and Magnus were hospitable hosts. Magnus greeted us when we arrived and showed us to our room. The room had a sink, firm bed, and towels. There were two bathrooms and we didn't run into any issues with other guests. Breakfast was provided and included basic fruit, bread, coffee, tea, etc. We messaged them in advance to see if they could provide dinner but unfortunately, they weren't able to. It was ok though because we ate at a delicious restaurant in Hofn. They also have two cute dogs on the property. I didn't see any other animals.

reviews.author: Billy
reviews.text: If you need a place to sleep,  go to this place.  Go here with no expectations, and most importantly go here and eat dinner!  We travelled all the way around Iceland and out of all 8 air bnbs this one was no doubt the most memorable.  I will be telling a great story about this place for many years!  Really happy we booked it!

reviews.author: Kim
reviews.text: We had a lovely time at this picturesque bed and breakfast.  The beds were comfortable and rooms and bathrooms very clean. The restaurant on site was closed the 1 night we were there so I cannot speak to dinners there, but we had a nice breakfast and tried one of their home brews which was very good. The hosts were so kind and helpful, we wished we could have stayed an additional night.

reviews.author: Jorge
reviews.text: Great place with absolutely beautiful views. Everything was clean and the hosts were warm and friendly. Great breakfast, too!

reviews.author: Julia
reviews.text: Guðrún and Magnús's guesthouse was amazing! They make a big effort to make you feel at home. The house was equipped with everything you need, quite big, very clean and cosy. They were very kind and helpful and we really enjoyed our stay - highly recommendable!

reviews.author: Declan
reviews.text: This place is a real gem!  Country style farm stay with a glacier in your backyard.  Oh and excellent dinner with great craft beers brewed in house. Amazing find in a remote location, the hosts are both lovely and friendly.  We didn’t want to leave!

reviews.author: Don
reviews.text: Room on a tranquil farm not far from Hofn. The hosts are delightful; the food is great. From the restaurant you’ll see three glaciers. Amazing.

reviews.author: Matthijs
reviews.text:
This place is truly amazing. The pictures don’t do it justice. Besides that the hosts are very nice and hospitable.
The bedroom is well equipped, there’s free coffee and there’s access to a well equipped kitchen. We ate at the restaurant of the owners which was a beautiful experience in itself.  Breakfast is equally outstanding. 
First we hiked to the glacier (18 km return) unfortunately the bridge at the end is unserviceable. When we got back we went to Hövn where they have a supermarket and we went to the public pool there which was great. At night we ate at the restaurant. Great experience. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Nancy
reviews.text: Wish we could’ve stayed longer or can come back soon! Magnús and his wife were friendly and sweet.  It’s very evident they put a lot of care into making sure guests feel comfortable and welcome. They were super communicative, and flexible with our late check in. The kitchen was well stocked with essentials and very useful as we got to cook a nice, hot late dinner when we arrived. Our room had a cute stuffed cow and I loved the personal touch. Later that night we went out to stargaze and actually saw the aurora borealis, and I was so thankful of how quiet and dark it is at Holmur. A little lamb even came up to us and let us pet him! Breakfast was the cherry on top, as it was an awesome spread in the nice restaurant part with various goods: coffee, tea, juice, cereal, fruit, breads, veggies and spreads. Highly recommend this place for people seeking homey comfort!

reviews.author: Pia
reviews.text: Beautiful farm house! Very nice and cozy restaurant space and the host was very kind to show us around event at 20:30 pm in the night! Thank you👍🏻😊

reviews.author: Sabarish
reviews.text: What an Amazing guest house! We reached after a long day and started off with some beer brewed at the premises. The room was so cute with a lovely view of the glaciers and farms. Breakfast was really nice and we had a long conversation with this amazing bunch of owners. They also gave us bread to feed their sheep and little lambs.  The place is so close to the ring road yet feels so distant and private.  Include this as a compulsory stopover in Iceland :) Worth it!

reviews.author: Eleanor
reviews.text: Very clean, very communicative, and adorable farm animals everywhere ! Loved it!

reviews.author: Anna
reviews.text:
We stayed here for three nights as our base for excursions in Southern Iceland. I loved the experience of being in a farm in Iceland! There were roosters, sheeps and ducks on the property. Their cat was my favorite. 
I had no problem taking a shower or using the shared bathrooms. The mattresses were very comfortable. Gudrun and Magnus operate a restaurant/brewery on the property, and I recommend trying the food if you have the chance. We were often exhausted from hiking all day, so it was nice to walk over from our room to the restaurant for warm soup and a good beer to unwind the day.

reviews.author: Aaron
reviews.text: great place, awesome view of glaciers (given its sunny), great restaurant and wondeful hosts. Loved this place. the hosts made me try hakarl. it was very sweet of them.

reviews.author: Louise
reviews.text:
Very enjoyable stay. Good location on the same site as an excellent restaurant. 
Rooms are basic but comfortable. We really enjoyed watching all of the animals. Breakfast is included and was very good.

reviews.author: Carrie
reviews.text: Stay here! It’s a pretty amazing! Mangus and Godrun are very thoughtful hosts and a pleasure to chat with!

reviews.author: Karan
reviews.text: We absolutely loved our stay at Gudrun and Magnus's guesthouse. They were very thoughtful hosts. The setting is amazingly beautiful with friendly animals all around. The room was spotless and very peaceful. We enjoyed eating dinner and breakfast in their little restaurant and only wish we could have stayed longer.

reviews.author: Conor
reviews.text: Had a nice stay at this farm house, complete with ducks, sheep, chickens, and cats!  The room was a good size and clean.  We didn't realize the bathroom was shared, but it was clean as well, and we didn't have too much waiting in the morning for showers.  The restaurant was very cozy with good food and local beer (would recommend reserving as it does fill up), and the includes breakfast was a good way to start the day. One note is that this is on a farm, so the animals are out and about in the morning.  It was a great place from which to explore southern Iceland!

reviews.author: Brian
reviews.text: One of my favorite Airbnb experiences to date. Amazing location, great communication, excellent hospitality. Room was accurately described and clean. Dinner option was incredible. Highly recommend. Wish we stayed there more!

reviews.author: Megan
reviews.text: A perfect, picturesque farm with great accommodations. The breakfast had a perfect variety and the coffee was tasty. We stayed for dinner and it was amazing! I had baked plaice and my boyfriend had the Shepherds Pie. Both were very good and very well prepared. The raspberry sour beer was amazing and we easily choose that over most other options. Overall it was a very enjoyable stay. The night we stayed the main house was all or mostly full, as there are 6 rooms so as long as you don’t mind a possibly busy house full of guests, it’s the perfect stop along the Ring Road.

reviews.author: Lisa
reviews.text:
Fabulous location while traveling the ring road. With the glacier in their backyard. 
The home brewed beer was very good. 
Highly recommend this place to everyone.

reviews.author: Agnetha
reviews.text: Nice place to stay with many playful touches.
reviews.original: Nette Unterkunft mit vielen verspielten Details.

reviews.author: Pip
reviews.text: We loved our two night stay at Gudrun and Magnus’ farm stay. It was full of character and the shepherds pie we ate on our first night was so good that we dined there again the next night and ate the same thing. The craft beers were great. Gudrun and Magnus seem like quiet hosts but are warm and welcoming when you get talking with them. We loved that the sheep were in the barn at the end of the accommodation building. We can definitely recommend this Air BnB. PS breakfast was great too.

reviews.author: Vicky
reviews.text: Its a fun and unique place to stay.  Definitely the most memorable we have ever had.

reviews.author: Samantha
