reviews.text: Magnus runs a great place that everyone should visit. The scenery is spectacular, the accomodation was extremely comfortable and homely. Magnus is a lovely host and has a lovely restaurant serving delicious food. Definitely worth the drive, if your considering. I definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Guillaume
reviews.text: You want to experience the truly Iceland experience ? You have to chose this stay. Perfect if you want to rest your mind after Jökulsárlón ;)

reviews.author: Sierra
reviews.text: Incredible! Beautiful farm with views of glaciers spilling from the mountains and baby lambs and tons of cute animals. Must have the dinner and homemade beer!! A dream stay!!! Dying to come back!

reviews.author: Barthélémy
reviews.text: Great little farm, perfect location in the glacier region, Magnus was a super nice host.

reviews.author: Christie
reviews.text: We stayed here as a stop along our trip around the Ring Road.  The accommodations were nice, and we especially liked having the small sink in our bedroom.  I would highly recommend eating dinner at their restaurant too.  The meals seem a bit pricey, but really it's what you'd expect to pay at most other restaurants in Iceland.  The food was top notch, and totally worth it!  The family was so friendly and polite as well, I highly recommend staying here.

reviews.author: Colleen
reviews.text: Great B&B, food was amazing and the views were nice. Roomy shower and good space in the rooms.

reviews.author: Charlotte
reviews.text: This place is incredibly beautiful, with such friendly hosts! We loved the animals, too. Breakfast was great, and it was so relaxing to have a drink in the restaurant after our long drive. Would absolutely recommend!

reviews.author: Riikka
reviews.text: Incredible views of the backyard, the place was easy to find, and we received a warm welcome and were shown around the premises. Breakfast was included in the price. Easy to recommend this place!
reviews.original: Mielettömät näkymät takapihalle, paikka oli helppo löytää ja meidät otettiin lämpimästi vastaan ja kierrätettiin paikat läpi. Hintaan kuului aamiainen. Paikkaa helppo suositella!

reviews.author: Hadi
reviews.text: Wow! What an amazing experience! I had a great time spending a night here with my friend. It was very unique and absolutely beautiful surroundings. Magnus and his wife were very kind and friendly. I would definitely come back and stay here.

reviews.author: Mirjaleena
reviews.text: Cute room with everything necessary there. Dinner at restaurant was superb and also the beer from their brewery.  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Helen
reviews.text: Great guesthouse with good breakfast. Lots of friendly animals too! Thank you.

reviews.author: Beth
reviews.text: Beautiful farm right next to a glacier. Gudrun was so kind and helpful!

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.text: We loved staying at Holmur Guesthouse! Breath-taking scenery, great rooms (loved the extra touch of having a sink in the room), comfortable beds, great breakfast (included). We opted to have dinner as well in the brewery/restaurant and it was seriously one of the best meals we have ever had. Beers were fantastic too. Would stay again in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: Aya
reviews.text: The room was thoughtfully decorated. We opted in for dinner at their restaurant, and we enjoyed the tasty food and farm-crafted beer. The host was friendly. Our only regret is missing breakfast because we had to leave before 8am.

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.text: Staying on this beautiful, cozy farm was one of the highlights of our trip to Iceland! The property is stunning, with views of the glaciers on a clear day. You have to eat at the restaurant when you stay here. We had one of the best meals of our lives. Guðrún's son-in-law is an incredibly talented chef and home brewer and the views from the restaurant are beautiful. The food is expensive by American standards, but worth every penny. We just wish we'd been there on a night when the family was playing music. :) Breakfast is also included, which was a nice surprise. Do yourself a favor and stay here if you want to eat great food, sleep in a cozy room, and get a small taste of life on an Icelandic farm.

reviews.author: Sharlene
reviews.text: I had a lovely stay with Guðrún and his wife. The guest house is very nice and clean and comfortable. I requested a vegetarian dinner and it was really delicious. The breakfast was good too. I definitely recommend staying here for a night - it was nice and quiet here when I stayed in the wintertime, and apparently in the summertime there are crowds and the restaurant/bar area is a really fun place to be!

reviews.author: Rebecca
reviews.text: Quiet and comfy.

reviews.author: Mia
reviews.text: The guesthouse was incredibly cozy and was situated in a beautiful location. We would DEFINITELY recommend this house for folks while they are on the south coast.

reviews.author: Julia
reviews.text:
Hands down the best dinner we had all week! The menu was set, it was mussel soup, Arctic trout over barley, and a chocolate fudge cake for dessert. My husband enjoyed a home brewed beer and I think it was the highlight of his trip! Room was cozy and warm, we slept like babies. Breakfast is included (dinner was not) and it was so so nice to have a real cup of coffee. 
We will be back! But next time in the summer :)

reviews.author: Alecia
reviews.text: This Airbnb was wonderful. We decided to make dinner reservations there the one night we stayed after exploring the south coast of Iceland. The Jon Riki restaurant and Brewery was amazing. In the winter there was only one menu option which was traditional Icelandic Lamb soup with bread. The meal and the beer were delicious!! For two people - two large bowls of soup (with unlimited refills) bread, dessert and two beers the total bill came to about $93 USD. The restaurant and brewery were very well decorated and picturesque. The home is about a 35 minute drive east of the glacier Lagoon and was a very easy drive on a nice day. The room we stayed in was very comfortable and clean. Good viewing for northern lights although they weren’t out during our stay. The room is located on a farm with many animals which we really enjoyed. The hosts were very friendly and welcoming. The hosts welcomed you and then let you enjoy your experience at their home and farm on your own which was very nice. Breakfast is included in the price. The items that were offered were cereal, toast, fruit and salad items. They even opened breakfast a little earlier for us because we had to check out earlier than the 8am start of breakfast which we greatly appreciated. Would definitely recommend to others and stay again if I am ever on the south coast of Iceland.

reviews.author: Lucy
reviews.text: Comfortable and convenient place just off Ring Road, about 30min drive from Jokulsarlon with a spectacular view of the glaciers. The hosts were incredibly gracious and welcoming. We had a delicious home-made dinner at the restaurant, which was a tad on the pricey side but a great meal nonetheless. Definitely a great place to stay if you're in the area!

reviews.author: Cédric
reviews.text: Atypical place in a large family farm and in nature between the mountain ranges (with a view of a glacier). Breakfast, hearty and varied, included in the price of the room. Gudrun and Magnus are very accessible people who are willing to engage in conversation. We even tasted the beer brewed by themselves as well as the lamb soup (very good) in their beautiful dining room. In the end a room in an old barn attached to the owners' house, very good for those who want to visit the glaciers around and Hofn.
reviews.original: Endroit atypique dans une grande ferme familiale et dans la nature entre les chaînes de montagne (avec vu sur un glacier). Petit-déjeuner, copieux et varié, compris dans le prix de la chambre. Gudrun et Magnus sont des gens très accessibles qui engagent la conversation volontiers. Nous avons même goûter la bière brasser par eux-mêmes ainsi que la soupe d’agneau (très bonne) dans leur belle salle de restauration. Au final une chambre dans une ancienne étable adjointe à la maison des propriétaires très bien pour ceux qui veulent visiter les glaciers aux alentours et Hofn.

reviews.author: Amanda
reviews.text: This is so cute! When we arrived we were greeted by the hosts and their two dogs which are so, so sweet! We had an incredible dinner and breakfast. If I could I would live here! The property is beautiful! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Rabih
reviews.text: Great hosts ! Love that place. Super clean comfortable beds and best of all amazing hospitality- would definitely come back during the summer - they have an amazing view of the glacier :)

reviews.author: Josh
reviews.text: Great base for exploring Jokulsarlon

reviews.author: Colin
reviews.text: Our favorite place we stayed in Iceland! It’s located on a beautiful property that is easily found via google maps. They served a good European style breakfast that I enjoyed thoroughly. The chef wasn’t there that evening so we didn’t get to try out the restaurant, but it looked like a fun place to be in high season when the place is full. Would definitely come back for a summer visit!

reviews.author: Sarah
reviews.text: The Holmur guesthouse was clean and the perfect location for our trip around Iceland!! The food was outstanding and we highly recommend you try their Farmhouse Ale!

reviews.author: Katie
reviews.text: We loved our time here! The guesthouse was cozy and comfortable, their restaurant was great-- both beer & food! We would absolutely stay there again!

reviews.author: Cj
reviews.text: This was our favorite stay in Iceland. The hosts were really friendly and helpful. Beautiful location. The highlight was the restaurant great food and beer!

reviews.author: Maria
reviews.text: Definitely top places to stay! It’s your best option if you’re trying to go to the glacier - closest and cheapest we found! The rooms are like little hotel rooms and there are shared bathrooms but i didn’t even feel like we were sharing because i never had to wait to use it and it was very clean! They have a restaurant which is decorated amazingly! They did it all themselves which is wonderful and from recycled materials very cool space! The dinner was the best we had in Iceland definitely reserve!!!! Home cooked meal so good! And they brew their own beer! Very kind couple that owns and runs the place and the breakfast is tasty and included! Would come back for sure!!!

reviews.author: Fanny
reviews.text:
Very quiet location full of perfect care.
Clementines cookies kettle and bags available. The kitchen may lack utensils but breakfast is at the top and these hosts are in its image. Super comfy mattress! We had a great evening/night 👏🏻
I highly recommend it.
reviews.original:
Emplacement très calme plein de petites parfaites attentions.
Clementines biscuits bouilloire et sachets à dispo. La cuisine manque peut être d'ustensiles mais le petit déjeuner est au top et ces hôtes à son image. Le matelas super confortable ! On a passé une super soirée/nuit 👏🏻
Je recommande vivement

reviews.author: Joann
reviews.text: Gudrun and Magnus were absolutely marvelous hosts! They were super clear and communicative, sharing very clear instructions on how to get to their place. The space was wonderful with so many sweet, lovely touches that made the place cozy, even on a cold winter night like when we stayed. We even got to see a gorgeous Northern Lights display behind the guest house that evening! We left after a plentiful breakfast in their awesome restaurant / brewery / live music venue. One of our favorite places on our trip to Iceland - we can't wait to come back and stay with them again!

reviews.author: Russell
reviews.text: This guesthouse is as exactly as described. It's right off ring road, has great views, and is an extremely cozy place. Magnús was there to greet us and show us around. We stayed on the second floor the guesthouse. Our room and bathroom were clean. Downstairs has a little kitchen, but we didn't need to use since we made a reservation at their restaurant/brewery for dinner and were provided breakfast in the morning. I strongly recommend having dinner at their restaurant. The food was delicious and beer was the best we had on our trip. We would like to visit Iceland in the summer and plan on staying here again.

reviews.author: Albert
reviews.text: Welcoming people, comfy room and a good breakfast :)

reviews.author: Jeremie
reviews.text: We had an amazing time during our stay. Location is beautiful, we had great food for dinner and breakfast, and that place has something magic. Especially when Northern lights are out.

reviews.author: Dave
reviews.text: Great friendly people.  Amazing lamb salad. Clean accommodations. Gorgeous views.  Cute animals.

reviews.author: 정수
reviews.text: Close to Ring Road, easy to access and the landlord will let you know the location in advance. The rustic house is clean and the shower is great.
reviews.original: 링로드와 가까워 접근성이 용이하며 집주인이 위치를 미리 잘 알려줍니다. 전원풍의 집으로 청결하며 샤워시설도 훌륭합니다

reviews.author: Christopher
reviews.text: We loved everything about this place - wish we had stayed longer.  The food was some of the best we had in Iceland, so don't forget to stop in for dinner.

reviews.author: Kristen
reviews.text: Perfect night stop between the golden circle and Vik. Our room was clean and warm and the kitchen is exactly what you need for some quick cheap meals.

reviews.author: Rebecca
reviews.text: Lovely guesthouse and view, with incredible food. The restaurant/brewery is an undiscovered gem and the best place we ate in Iceland. The hosts are friendly, but give space to the guests. You can walk around the farm and view the glaciers. Very secluded but large open farmland with some neighbors.

reviews.author: Rebecca
reviews.text: Great stay and tasty restaurant. Loved their food and friendliness. Their micro brewery was amazing.

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.text: Amazing views and very comfortable rooms. Have dinner at the restaurant at least once and try the homemade beer made on site. Best food we had in Iceland! The skyr beer with berries was fantastic (if you like the taste of yogurt) and the shepherds pie was amazing.

reviews.author: Donna
reviews.text: This was a very warm welcoming place.  We arrived late after a long day on the road, and Gudrun and her daughter make sure we were shown our room and received all information we needed. Our room in the former cow barn, which appeared newly renovated, was very clean and comfortable.  It had a sink, which was nice, with two bathrooms just down the hall. The restaurant was in a separate building, with a view of the glacier out the window. The breakfast was excellent, with a large buffet to choose from.  Such a comfortable place, I wished we were staying more than one night.  Gudrun personally greeted all the guests at breakfast, and was very solicitous to their needs. She and Magnus even helped me track down information about my Icelandic ancestors who lived in Myrar!  Five stars to these kind, helpful and hardworking hosts!

reviews.author: 迪
reviews.text: Amazing house
reviews.original: 很棒的房子

reviews.author: Ellen
reviews.text: A charming rustic farm with sheep and goats and a glacier behind! The food was wonderful and the conversation delightful.

reviews.author: Andrew
reviews.text: This was the best AirBnB I've ever been to!

reviews.author: Kelly
reviews.text: We loved our stay here. We stayed in the room next to the barn and could hear the sheep. Great breakfast with a beautiful view of the glacier.

reviews.author: Oliver
reviews.text: My only regret was that my stay was so short. I arrived a bit late and so missed out on dinner, so I will have to return so that I can try their restaurant :). Breakfast was included and filling. View was of course great, glacier was in the near distance. I enjoyed my brief stay at this unique little spot and hope to return.

reviews.author: Cassandre
reviews.text: Stunning Ghesthouse! Very clean, located at the west entrance of Höfn. The farm is cute and the goats wake us up even in the morning! Very nice experience in a typical Icelandic hostel! All that is missing would be a washing machine, otherwise the small kitchen, internet and breakfast included were wonderful.
reviews.original: Superbe Ghesthouse! Très propre, situé à l'entrée ouest de Höfn. La ferme est mignonne et les chèvres nous réveillent même le matin! Très belle expérience dans une auberge typiquement islandaise! Tout ce qui manque serait une machine à laver, sinon la petite cuisine, l'Internet et le petit-déjeuner inclut étaient merveilleux.

reviews.author: Maryse
reviews.text: Good hospitality, good beer brewed on site, very good meal and small animals very popular with children.
reviews.original: Bon accueil, bonne bière brassée sur place, très bon repas et petits animaux très apprécié des enfants.

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.text:
This is the very best place you can stay when visiting Iceland! It is shows you the true meaning of Iceland! Family values are deep on this family farm, bnb and restaurant! We had a cozy room with the comfiest bed! Our view was of the mountains on one side and the plains on the other, absolutely gorgeous!
The baby goats provide some comic relief after a long day of hiking or a great way to start your morning!
Food is absolutely delicious! Having breakfast was always a yummy start to our day! We ate dinner there one night and were treated to Icelandic lamb, mashed potatoes, carrots and parsnips-it was the best meal we have eaten!! So tasty and full of flavour! My compliments to the chef! We also had a chance to try some of the locally made beer which is a must!
The hosts are the kindest people! They have a genuine care and interest in their guests! We asked for suggestions of what to explore locally! The glacier hike (seen from the restaurant) and geothermal hottubs were reccomended! Both were incredible! Check them out if you are in the area!
This place is full of Icelandic charm! They have an international money wall displayed in their restaurant, so if you can, bring a bill to put up!
You should definitely stay here and I already can't wait to visit again!!
P.s. Ask about the Hidden People, it's quite the story!!!

reviews.author: Michelle
reviews.text: Lovely room (includes a sink) but the real sales point is the view and the beautiful food. You can have dinner in their restaurant, even though my husband and I were the only ones there we were still cooked a beautiful dinner (for a reasonable price). Breakfast is included and there was a lot on offer. We had a great nights sleep. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text: Exactly what I was looking for. A rustic, quiet guesthouse located on a small farm in stunning setting with 3 glaciers just a few km away. The dogs, cats and horses were so friendly, and it was a unexpected treat to wake up to reindeer grazing on the lawn. The owners were incredibly friendly and helpful, and dinner at their bar/restaurant was delicious.

reviews.author: Renata
reviews.text: Very nice place if you like farm life. We just loved songs of thousands of wild birds together with yard guard gander :) Host makes fantastic beer, a must to try. Breakfast was delicious and very different form other places because of variety of fruits, cheeses and tasty coffee. Thanks for perfect stay!

reviews.author: Julia
reviews.text: Very cozy place, good breakfast and owners are very nice.

reviews.author: Cristian
reviews.text: The room was so cute!! And all was very cleaning, also you can use the kitchen, that's very important and you have everything! When you are arriving you can see a indication with the name of the house!! For sure, we will repeat it if we come back Iceland!

reviews.author: Viktoria
reviews.text: Our short stay here was fabulous. Everything was just perfect: themed rooms, delicious dinner and beer in the stylish restaurant, remoted location and very sweet and friendly hosts. Definitely recommended! Was our best a accommodation in Iceland so far!

reviews.author: Joshua
reviews.text: Great and charming rural location! The breakfast was an excellent start to our morning.

reviews.author: Caleb
reviews.text: Warm welcome, comfortable bed and good food, amazing home brewed beer! Recommended if you are passing though the area!

reviews.author: Heather
reviews.text:
The property is close to Jökulsárlón so it was a good place to stay the night before our glacier tour. 
Our hosts were very kind, we had a beer at the bar/restaurant while a local blues band played which was fun :-) and a hearty breakfast in the morning.
The shower had some serious hot water which was great on a cold night too!
A few other groups were staying the same night as we did, there is a kitchen area to hang out if you want to meet other travelers but our bedroom was quiet- we did not hear others walking around from our room so it's still private and quiet. I would recommend staying here if you're seeing the glacier or Höfn!

reviews.author: Line
reviews.text: It was a real nice stay, meeting with the family and the animals, we loved staying at Gudrun and Magnus' farm. Definitely a place to stay and stop for a beer or meal for the glaciers view, the food/drinks and the people.  They are really nice people.

reviews.author: Myles
reviews.text: Wow what a wonderful place! It's a great farmhouse and Magnus and Gideon were so hospitable and kind. Dinner was mushroom soup and local kolé (like flounder but in the shape of a manta ray. Dogs were friendly too and wifi was fast! In room sink was a plus

reviews.author: Jordan
reviews.text: Don't be frightened by the B&B moniker that comes with this place. The host is very friendly, helps you get acquainted with the house and your room, but also lets you keep to yourself if desired. Pro tip: you MUST join them for dinner. The owner's son made us one of our favorite meals of the trip, and also brews his own beer (he had 5+ varieties - 3 of which we tried, all delicious). If you are looking to live like an Icelander, this is the place.

reviews.author: Ruben
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay here. Guodrun and Magnus were extremely hospitable. Our room was clean and comfortable and had a sink as well. Breakfast was in their beautifully designed restaurant that looked out into the Icelandic mountains. Great way to start off the day!

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.text:
Every place has hotels, but is there anything more authentic than staying in a remodeled cowshed on a farm in the middle of Iceland? What if I told you that you could have unobscured snowy mountain views right out your window? But wait, it gets better... there is a restaurant. With a bar. With BREAKFAST INCLUDED! (And if you know how expensive Iceland's food can be, you know you have just won the lottery.)
This place is adorable and a good value. You're close to touristy nature locations, but far enough away from towns to fully absorb a peaceful Icelandic night under a starry sky (or cloudy one, you know how unpredictable Iceland weather can be!)
If you like cats and are in our room, if you are patient, you just might be lucky enough to run into the beautiful, fluffy cat in the portrait in your room

reviews.author: Shenmin
reviews.text: This place is great and the host is very friendly and helpful. We had a really great time there!

reviews.author: Goyeneche
reviews.text: The room is really nice and the place is amazing. Very calm and with a view on the glacier. Perfect place to see the northern lights (if you are lucky). The breakfast was excellent too.

reviews.author: Felix
reviews.text: Guðrún and Magnús’s family run guesthouse was simply perfect. We were so warmly greeted from the outset and made to feel at home. The guesthouse is just off the ringroad so ideal if you're travelling along the East coast (perfect location for access to Jökulsárlón and not far to Skaftafell) plus you can see 3 glaciers from the farm.  We arrived in time to try some of their home brew which was a delicious IPA brewed with oats. Our room was very clean and comfortable and the municipal shower was great. Breakfast was the best we've experienced in all of Iceland and Guðrún's homemade egg salad was out of this world. Really lovely place and people, cannot recommend any higher!

reviews.author: Katie
reviews.text: This bnb was my favorite place to stay in Iceland. Great hosts, the cutest animals and the best food we had all trip. The home brewed beer was just an added bonus!

reviews.author: Ruben
reviews.text: We arrived late at night (10pm) while it was raining and we left very early (7am) so we did not get to see any of the property or even get to enjoy the included breakfast. The room was clean and so was the bathroom. The room was a good size and it had a sink which is great since it is a shared bathroom with the house.

reviews.author: Pavel
reviews.text: The place is good! I really enjoyed it. They also serve free breakfast, so it helped to save a lot of money for us because everything is so expensive in Iceland. The place is located in between of nowhere. There is nothing around, only unique icelandic nature

reviews.author: Julienne
reviews.text:
We stayed two nights, and it was a very clean and comfortable stay. 
Gudrun provided recommendations to eat and sight-see, as well it was nice to have breakfast in their newly renovated restaurant. Since we arrived in the Winter, it wasn't open, but were still able to pre-order our dinner for one night and enjoy a wonderful meal and beer tasting. I hear it's lovely in the summer and they have live music on the weekends. 
They have the sweetest dog that greets you at the door. 
We would highly recommend staying here, if you want to be in between Hofn and the Glacier Lagoon (where we had to meet for our Ice Cave Tour).  This was a beautiful, remote place to stay, with the view of the mountain and the Northern Lights. Unfortunately it was cloudy during our stay and we were unable to see it. Gudrun was so kind as to let us know before she went to bed if she saw it.

reviews.author: Julia
reviews.text: restaurant and beer was the highlight of this airbnb!

reviews.author: Saskia
reviews.text: Great place to stay at, and ideal to see the northern lights but the weather was against us on our trip. It was difficult to find the location in the dark because of how secluded. I highly recommend having a GPS when traveling around Iceland. Eventually we found it. The turn off from ring road one is a small sign but it is clear you just have to really pay attention.

reviews.author: Chiang
reviews.text: Cool place,spectacular scenery and the best aurora.

reviews.author: 宇翔
reviews.text: It is located in a really nice place and you can even see the northern lights in there. The room is clean and comfortable ! We really like it.

reviews.author: Caroline
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about our stay with Magnus and Gudhrun! Cozy private guesthouse room and such a beautiful view. 10 minute drive to majestic lakes and glacier walks and they run a surprisingly delicious restaurant/brewery on site. They are also very friendly and interesting to talk to! This has been our favourite stay on the Ring Road so far :)

reviews.author: Erin
reviews.text:
This was a wonderful spot. Comfortable , clean, quiet and an absolutely lovely couple. Friendly and helpful and accommodating . It was a pleasure to stay with them. if you choose to have supper on thier resturant on the property you will not be dissapointed . 
Would recommend !

reviews.author: Jenn
reviews.text: Very quaint place. It was a great place to relax and enjoy the scenery. There was a glacier behind the house!

reviews.author: Richard
reviews.text: This place was great to stay at. It was close enough to Hofn to drive and get some dinner but also far enough that we could see the Northern lights! They have a restaurant as part of their property which Guorun makes  amazing lamb chops. The complimentary breakfast was great

reviews.author: Kristin
reviews.text: we were only there for a few hours in the dark so didnt get a chance to really experience it. would've loved to try the beer. overall good house, nice&private.

reviews.author: Laia
reviews.text:
We arrived late and left early in the morning. But we had a wonderful night.  It's a calm place, the only things you can hear are the animals on the farm and the wind in the trees.
Magnus welcomed us in the evening and showed us around. We could choose at what time we would like to have our breakfast. Gudrun, a very friendly lady, welcomed us in the morning with a warm smile. What a good start into the day. Thank you. :-)

reviews.author: Kristyn
reviews.text: Awesome stay, definitely order dinner and try their beer! Wonderful breakfast included in the morning as well. Comfortable accommodations...shared bathrooms

reviews.author: Denise
reviews.text: Hólmur is a beautiful, remote farm with a spectacular view.  We were able to observe the Northern Lights on a clear night, but even if we hadn't, the view would have sufficed. The home-cooked meal we ordered one night was delicious!

reviews.author: JongBum
reviews.text: we loved staying at this place! the host was really nice and kindly greeted us.  also the room was clean and cozy. we also had the dinner and breakfast that the host provided and they were amazing. we could also try some beer that the host brewed himself and that was wonderful as well. and there were many different kinds of animals including dogs sheep goats rabbits and a cat-good place for animal lovers. thank you so much for this fantastic stay!

reviews.author: Valerie
reviews.text: We thoroughly enjoyed our time at the guesthouse. The farm is quaint and cozy and very restful and couldn't have been more perfectly located given our itinerary. Gudrún and Magnús are very warm and welcoming hosts and prepared an amazing dinner the night we arrived. We would certainly love to stay here again when we have an opportunity to visit Iceland again.

reviews.author: Bogdan
reviews.text: Great place to stay on the Ring Road. The chef/brewmaster at the restaurant is very talented. Our food and beer were spectacular! This was the first place we saw the northern lights too on our trip and the view was amazing. I would definitely recommend staying here during your time near Hofn.

reviews.author: Meaghan
reviews.text: This place was very cool! We loved the bar, restaurant and live music! Food was delicious and the rooms were nice and warm!

reviews.author: Johannes
reviews.text: Nice hosts. Had a Beer tasting with the Boss in the morning. Home-brew-super-Ale! Thank you!

reviews.author: Daniel
reviews.text: Friendly and inviting host. Comfortable bed with good wifi. The brewery had good beers to offer, and their dinner (extra charge) was stellar. Breakfast included in the morning was very convenient.

reviews.author: Kendra
reviews.text: This place was easy to find and very cozy. Perfect for long drives or if you want an amazing open view. the hosts were some of the nicest people i encountered and very good cooks. the farm barn/restaurant/brewery was amazing. my bed was comfortable and i had everything i needed for my stay. Host have some great beer and food they also are very informed. I overslept past check out and they were very nice about it. Stay here is worth it.

reviews.author: Adam
reviews.text: This is a lovely farm run by a very nice family. The room we stayed in for our needs just perfectly. The beds were comfortable but they were 2 twins pushed together. Completely fine for us, but nice to know for others who may care. The restaurant/brewery (Jon Riki) is closed in the winter but they will cook meals for the guests at an extra charge if requested. Let me tell you...the food is phenomenal! The chef and brew master is a pro in the kitchen. We had bacon and tomato soup for a starter and fresh caught (by his friend that day) Icelandic Trout. Our best meal in Iceland by far.

reviews.author: Seva
reviews.text: The room was great and the vista awesome - if you're a light sleeper bring ear plugs like many places in iceland the walls arent super insulated and you can easily hear all the other rooms around you.  The kitchen didn't have all the essentials but we were able to make do just fine.  Brewery and breakfast super awesome! Overall a wonderful place to stay

reviews.author: Robert
reviews.text:
We enjoyed staying at the farm! Great views up to the mountains and glaciers, which we only got to enjoy on our last day due to late arrivals and early departures -- too bad! A highlight for us was the food. They had an offer of the day for the two nights we stayed. Both dinners were delightful. As others have mentioned, they also brew on-site... I thought the beer was exceptional.
Accommodations were nice. We stayed in a farmhouse with six rooms and two bathrooms (shared). The rooms were cozy and nicely heated.

reviews.author: Kristyn
reviews.text: Amazing farm with a panoramic view of incredible glaciers. Brewery and restaurant steps from our room with fantastic food and local beer. The highlight of our stay in Iceland!!!

reviews.author: Gillianne
reviews.text:
What a wonderful view of the glacier and the mountains . This was excellent for the view , the home cooked meal ,the beers brewed on site and the breakfast spread . 
The rooms were clean and warm with fresh linen . Gudrun and his wife were wonderful hosts and even recommended a few places to visit when our tours got cancelled . 
I'll be back for sure !

reviews.author: Jordan
reviews.text: Our stay here was wonderful! The guesthouse was very clean and comfy, and a kitchen space allowed us to do some cooking. The breakfast in the morning was good too and the space was warm and cozy. Magnus let us walk around the grounds and meet the animals too, which made this stay all the more special. I would definitely go back!

reviews.author: Taylor
reviews.text:
An absolute must-stay if you are in the Hofn area!  We drove up to see the glacial lagoon and to visit the region and booked this last second and we were very glad that we did! This is a great experience in Iceland and you will be staying on essentially a small farm. The rooms are great, the shower warm and breakfast was even included (a rarity in Iceland for us)! 
On top of all that, there is a restaurant and brewery (!) on the farm, which is newly renovated and done with great style and taste. The host were very kind and generous, even giving us free tastings of their beers, including their soon-to-be kegged Christmas Ale. I will definitely be staying here if I am in the area again.

reviews.author: Brianna
reviews.text: Holmur Guesthouse is just what we were looking for on our Iceland trip! After taking in the sites and visiting little towns, it was really nice to be able to come to a place so cozy and quiet. Everything was so clean, and the breakfast was amazing! We checked in around 5:30pm with no problem. The only part I wish we had been able to experience was visiting the on-site bar/restaurant. This will definitely be a stop on our next trip to beautiful Iceland!

reviews.author: Jim
reviews.text: I loved this stop on our trip through southern Iceland. This guesthouse is situated on a farm just west of Höfn with incredible views of glaciers and surrounding farmland. They have a lot of adorable and friendly sheep, horses, dogs, geese, and a cat, that we saw. The kitchen was a bit lacking, but they do have a restaurant on site which brews its own beer! Sadly we weren't able to try the beer during our stay, but I'm sure it is delicious. One thing that was above and beyond was their breakfast! They invited us to a free breakfast at the restaurant in the morning, which was the perfect start to our day. Guðrún and Magnús were very welcoming and friendly throughout the entire experience. I would happily return to their guesthouse.

reviews.author: Nate
reviews.text: Wonderful spot in a beautiful place! Great breakfast and a cozy little room in a charming old house. Surrounded by animals and nature plus the mountains, this is a delightful spot!

reviews.author: Shaun
reviews.text: This place was an absolute score! The family is very friendly and accommodating and the son-in-law operates an up and coming 3bbl microbrewery on site. If your a craft beer enthusiasts like my wife and I, this should definitely be a stopping point during your travels.
